title: Fusion Export: AI Defense
description: Sophos AI Defense: AI application use, what policies blocked or warned, sanctioning status, users and policies.

list.name: ai_snapshot
list.label: Snapshot
list.description: The AI application, user and license snapshot to show. The newest is picked on load.

options.content: Unofficial: built on the CSV tables of the Unofficial Sophos Fusion Data Exporter, not a Sophos product. Dates are in the exporter's report time zone. Activity panels follow the time range; the application, user and license panels show the snapshot picked above, which covers the exporter's inventory window (30 days by default).
